description: Alessandro Mingotti and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. The workbook contains all measurements collected for the named Rogowski-coil study of proximity, burden and position effects. Coverage is that calibration experiment, with exact current waveforms, position ranges, repetition counts and observation dates unspecified in the native description. The source establishes a concrete role in assessing power-quality measurement accuracy of grid current sensors. Related IT4PQ records investigate other influence factors, including temperature/humidity and magnetic fields; those records do not prove independent instrument populations. Zenodo supplies the deposited data and native file inventory with open access under cc-by-4.0. Sample values, linked files and code were not read or executed during source checks. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations.
